title: Analysis and Replay
summary: Write a corrected market slice, keep the earlier head alive, and compare grouped post-trade analysis across revisions.
whySQLiteFallsShort: SQLite can hold the rows, but correction-aware analysis across named storage revisions is not a built-in workflow.
SydraDB lets a team keep the earlier head, write the corrected slice, and then query both revisions without inventing a separate replay database.
That makes data-correction drills and post-trade reruns easier to explain to reviewers, ops teams, and managers.

steps.title: Register the trade schema
steps.summary: Keep the market-data contract explicit inside the CAS-backed workspace.

steps.title: Register the quote schema
steps.summary: Keep the quote family explicit before the corrected slice arrives.

steps.title: Write the original market slice
steps.summary: Seed the original cross-venue trade and quote rows that the desk first saw before a correction was published.

steps.title: Let the original slice settle
steps.summary: Give the local engine time to flush the original rows before we name the earlier storage head.

steps.title: Capture the original head
steps.summary: Name the current storage head before the correction arrives so the desk can compare analysis across both versions later.

steps.title: Write the corrected market slice
steps.summary: Post the corrected cross-venue rows into the active head while keeping the earlier storage revision named and queryable.

steps.title: Let the corrected slice settle
steps.summary: Pause before replay analysis so the corrected rows and their active head are visible to the analysis endpoints.

steps.title: Run markout on the earlier revision
steps.summary: Compute post-trade markout against the original head before the correction landed.

steps.title: Run markout on the current head
steps.summary: Recompute the same markout request against the corrected head so the difference is explicit.

steps.title: Inspect grouped quote quality by venue on the corrected head
steps.summary: Keep a second post-trade lens visible on the corrected head so the revision story shows venue-level quote quality, not just one slippage view.

steps.title: Inspect what changed in storage
steps.summary: Compare the named original head and the current head so the correction is visible at the storage layer too.
